title: Kicked up Greek lamb Kebabs
description: A sour, chewy, and energizing Greek dish featuring coriander leaves and shio-cure, perfect for a Whole30-friendly meal
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together shio-cure, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube
Grill the kebabs for 10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit
During the last 2 minutes of grilling, sprinkle the chopped coriander leaves over the kebabs
Remove the kebabs from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional coriander leaves if desired
